title: Baroque 1
description: Revise concepts associated with Baroque up to Advanced Higher. These features and forms may also occur in other periods.

items.prompt: The historical musical period approximately 1600–1750, associated with continuo, contrapuntal writing and composers such as Bach and Handel.
Name the general term for a decorative note or group added to a melody, rather than one particular type of decoration.
Pressing a key plucks a string inside this keyboard instrument.
An end-blown woodwind instrument with finger holes and a whistle-like mouthpiece.
Give the general term for a solo song within an opera or oratorio, rather than a specific ABA type of that song.
A rapid repeated alternation between a main note and the note immediately above it in the scale.
Two or more independent melodic lines sound together. Give the texture term ending in -phonic.
A multi-note bass melody repeats unchanged in pitch and rhythm while the upper parts develop. Name this repeating-bass device.
A large concert work telling a sacred or biblical story through soloists, choir and orchestra, without theatrical acting, scenery or costumes.
Give the Italian-derived operatic term for speech-like solo singing used to advance dialogue or narrative, often alternating with arias.
A very short crushed grace note played immediately before the main note.
A short ornament in which the main note moves rapidly to the adjacent note above or below and returns.
